title: testing-js
label: JEST
desc: Jest and Vitest: write, mock, and run JavaScript tests from the CLI.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install the runner and initialize a project config.

snippets.code:
# Jest: zero-config for plain JavaScript projects
npm install --save-dev jest
npx jest --init

# Vitest: reuses the Vite config and transform pipeline
npm install --save-dev vitest

# Run a single file, a single test by name, or stay in watch mode
npx jest src/cart.test.js
npx jest -t "applies discount"
npx jest --watch

sections.title: First Test
sections.description: A test file is plain JavaScript that calls test and expect.

sections.title: Assertions
sections.description: Pick the matcher that matches the comparison you actually mean.

sections.title: Mocking
sections.description: Replace modules, stub return values, and spy on calls.

sections.title: Async
sections.description: Await promises in the test body or assert on them with resolves and rejects.

sections.title: Lifecycle
sections.description: Shared setup runs beforeAll, per-test setup runs beforeEach.

sections.title: Snapshots
sections.description: Store rendered output once and fail when it changes unexpectedly.

sections.title: Matchers
sections.description: Structural matchers and table-driven cases cover most assertions.

sections.title: Coverage
sections.description: Report coverage locally and enforce a threshold in CI.

snippets.code:
# Text summary plus an HTML report under coverage/lcov-report
npx jest --coverage
npx jest --coverage --collectCoverageFrom='src/**/*.js'

# CI: fail the build when coverage drops below the threshold
npx jest --ci --coverage --coverageThreshold='{"global":{"lines":80,"branches":70}}'

sections.title: Configuration
sections.description: One config file pins the environment, test pattern, and setup files.

snippets.code:
npx jest --config jest.config.js
npx jest --runInBand          # serial run, easier to debug
npx jest --detectOpenHandles  # find handles that keep the process alive

sections.title: Vitest Differences
sections.description: Same assertions, explicit imports and a Vite-based runner.

snippets.code:
# Same assertions, different runner
npx vitest run                 # single pass, no watch
npx vitest --coverage
npx vitest -u                  # update snapshots

# API mapping: jest.fn() -> vi.fn(), jest.mock() -> vi.mock()

sections.title: Common Errors
sections.description: Messages you will hit first, and the fix for each.

snippets.code:
# Clear the transform cache after changing Babel or TypeScript config
npx jest --clearCache

# Run one failing test with full output
npx jest src/cart.test.js -t "applies discount" --verbose
